node.statement: Theorem 6.1 (Theorem 1.5 — Mix(GPS) moments, loose): For Mix(GPS) on n copies of rank-r state rho, E[rho_hat_v tensor rho_hat_v] = ((n-1)/n)rho^2 + (1/n)(rho tensor I + I tensor rho)SWAP + (r/n^2)SWAP - Lower_rho where Lower_rho in SoS(d). Proof: Start from the pure-state GPS second moment formula (Lemma 5.5) applied to the purification |rho_bar> in C^{dr}. The marginals of |rho_bar>^{tensor n} match those of rho: (psi_sym)_1 = sigma_{rho_bar}, etc. Taking partial trace over B-registers, use Proposition 2.1 (SoS preserved under partial trace), Proposition 2.5 (SWAP factorization), and Proposition 2.6. The SWAP on C^{dr} tensor C^{dr} becomes (SWAP_A tensor SWAP_B), and tr_{B1B2}(SWAP_{AB}) = r * SWAP_A, yielding the r/n^2 coefficient.
